description: This file defines the interface IRemoteInstantiation for remote instantiation and termination of components within the Thunder plugin system. It includes method declarations for Instantiate and Kill, and contains detailed comments and licensing information.

classes.name: IRemoteInstantiation
classes.description: Interface for remote instantiation and termination of components, providing methods Instantiate and Kill.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates a new remote component instance with specified parameters such as library, class, user, group, and environment settings.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Terminates a remote component instance identified by requestId.
